messages:
Anika (CS): Hey team — Valora Labs is stuck on the DPA onboarding step. They want explicit confirmation on key provenance and whether we can support a customer-managed key (BYOK) for embeddings storage. They marked this as blocking their production switch. 

Jared (SEng): Quick q — is this for hosted API or Dedicated? BYOK options differ.

Anika (CS): Hosted API. They want keys isolated for embeddings only, and they asked if we can provide HSM-backed wrapping or if they must upload pre-wrapped blobs.

Priya (PM): We should check the DPA clause they attached. Can someone confirm the exact wording we can commit to? I can offer a timeline to customer once we know the answer.

Rajat (Security): TL;DR: we support customer-managed keys via our KMS integration for Dedicated and VPC Private; hosted currently supports AWS KMS with EKM for enterprise customers (HSM-backed). For embeddings at-rest, we can provide envelope encryption where customer key wraps the data key.

Rajat (Security): More detail: we do not accept raw customer private keys. Pattern is: customer provides a key in their cloud KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) and we call Encrypt/Decrypt via EKM. For HSM-based attestation, we can show logs/assertions but we don't hand over HSM certs.

Jared (SEng): Example config snippet we use internally for EKM call (for reference):
```
KMS_PROVIDER=aws
KMS_KEY_ALIAS=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-1234
EKM_MODE=enabled
EMBEDDINGS_ENC= envelope
```

Anika (CS): Helpful. Customer specifically asked: "Can you sign a DPA addendum that says 'keys are customer-owned and never exported by Redwood' ?"

Rajat (Security): We can agree to "customer-owned" for keys that live in their KMS and are not exported by us, yes. But we need to include an implementation caveat: if customer requests Redwood to perform a restore/migration and provides a wrapped blob, support teams may need temporary access under documented procedures. Suggest wording: "Customer retains ownership of KMS keys. Redwood does not store or export unwrapped customer keys; any operational use of wrapped materials is subject to documented change-control and customer approval."

Priya (PM): Can we get legal to sign that exact phrasing? I can loop legal but need a security-approved line to propose.

Rajat (Security): I'll draft a short security blurb and include references to SOC2 controls we map to this flow (CC6: key management, CC7: cryptographic operations).

sec-bot: New internal doc created: https://redwood.example.com/internal/dpa/byok-embedding-patterns — please review.

Jared (SEng): Two engineering notes for the team: 1) we need a simple onboarding checklist for Hosted BYOK customers (KMS ARN, IAM role for Redwood, test encrypt/decrypt), 2) confirm metrics: will embedding ops add 5-10ms per call due to remote KMS? Might be higher depending on EKM latency.

Anika (CS): I'll send a short reply to Valora with the current stance and ask for KMS provider + urgency. Draft reply: "We support customer-managed keys via supported cloud KMS with envelope encryption; Redwood does not export unwrapped keys. We'll provide a DPA addendum with clarifying language and a short onboarding checklist. Can you confirm your KMS provider and whether you require HSM attestation?" Any edits? :eyes:

Priya (PM): LGTM. Add expected ETA: legal + security sign-off in 3 business days if no novel requests.

Rajat (Security): I'll post the security blurb here by EOD and ping legal.

Anika (CS): Thanks — I'll update the customer and tag this as "onboarding-blocking" in the CRM. Will follow up after your blurb. :thumbsup:

Jared (SEng): FYI — opened ENG ticket ENG-7834 to add a BYOK onboarding template and perf-run notes.

Anika (CS): Perfect — closing loop in this thread once legal confirms.

sec-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up in 72 hours.
notes: conversation focused on hosted DPA, BYOK, KMS/ HSM, and onboarding next steps
